items.name: Columnar speedups
items.text: Reads only needed columns & skips row groups/stripes via min/max stats. Similar values compress well via dictionary and RLE.

items.name: Splittability
items.text: Workers read parts in parallel when row groups compress independently (Parquet/ORC). One large .csv.gz cannot split.

items.name: File sizing
items.tag: AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, Amazon Data Firehose
items.text: Target 128 MB–1 GB files for Spark/Athena; tiny files add overhead. Compact via Glue, Athena CTAS, Iceberg, or Firehose buffers.

items: Default: Parquet/ORC + Snappy/ZSTD + balanced partitions (avoid tiny files).
GZIP CSV shrinks size but skips no columns and breaks parallel splitting.
Avro is row-based: use for Kafka/schema evolution, not columnar queries.
Firehose format conversion needs JSON input plus a Glue table schema.

blocks.caption: Use row formats for landing/streaming; columnar for analytics.
blocks.heading: Row vs columnar formats

points: CSV/TSV: text, no schema; simple export, slow queries.
JSON lines: nested, self-describing; verbose for logs.
Avro: binary, schema evolution for Kafka & streaming.
left.title: Row-based

points: Parquet: binary, nested; Athena, Spectrum, Spark, Glue.
ORC: binary, embedded schema; best for Hive ecosystem.
Pruning, pushdown & better compression cut scan costs.
